name: Card
doc: Card (the command): the root and the director - the sparkles, the two rings, the shards, the screen flash, the sound; carded (target record +3 bit 2 clear): the target fading, the card spinning out of it, the twelve small cards with their trails; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag182_card.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The sparkles, the two rings, the shards, the screen flash, the sound; carded: the target fading, the card spinning out of it, the twelve small cards with their trails; the action result
